name: Diagnostic Medical Equipment Inc.
old_description: With over 15 years of expertise in healthcare, our core values are founded on mutual service and efficient delivery.
about:
Diagnostic Medical Equipment Inc. operates from Moore, Oklahoma, where it was founded in 2011. The company is led by CEO Arun Mirchia and has built a focus on supplying ultrasound systems to healthcare providers worldwide.

The firm distributes a broad range of GE Healthcare ultrasound platforms, including the Voluson, Logiq, and Vivid product families. Its inventory spans dozens of models — from the Voluson E10 and Logiq E9 to the Vivid E95 — and the company states it holds the largest stock of GE ultrasound units in the United States. Orders are supported by global shipping and crating services, with customer support available around the clock.

Customers include hospitals, polyclinics, and health centres seeking diagnostic imaging equipment. The company serves medical professionals and institutions across international markets, emphasizing quick response and logistics handling.

Diagnostic Medical Equipment says its founding principle was mutual service and efficient delivery, and it maintains a continuously updated inventory to match evolving clinical needs. The combination of deep product availability and 24/7 access is presented as its core differentiation.
